description: Retrieval golden set for Agronaut's knowledge base. Queries are written in OPERATOR voice — symptom-first, messy, and deliberately NOT phrased in the vocabulary of the documents that should answer them. That vocabulary gap is the point: a retriever that only matches document titles scores well on keyword-shaped queries and fails real users. `relevant` lists the source files a correct retrieval should surface; a query may legitimately have more than one.

fish crowding near the water inlet and breathing fast

the oldest leaves are turning pale first while new growth looks fine
my water has gone bright green and cloudy
stringy green growth clogging the pipes and screens

little white dots all over my fish like grains of salt
can I use a copper based treatment with plants in the loop

negative_controls.query: how do I fix a slipping bicycle chain
what is the capital of Canada
write me a python function to reverse a linked list
what time does the pharmacy close today
recommend a good science fiction novel
how do I change a flat car tyre
explain the offside rule in football
best way to remove red wine from a carpet
who won the world cup in 1998

_negative_controls_note: Off-topic queries that MUST NOT return a confident citation. Their score distribution is what calibrates the relevance floor: the floor is only trustworthy if the off-topic band separates cleanly from the worst on-topic score. More controls = a more honest margin.
